DAVIS WRIGHT TREMAINE, LLP FOR CROSS DEFENDANT/OPPOSING PARTY, WLG CORPORATION. MOTION ARGUED. COURT'S RULING AFTER HEARING: TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. CROSS-COMPLAINANT'S APPLICATION FOR WRIT OF ATTACHMENT IS DENIED. THE APPLICATION DOES NOT MAKE AN EVIDENTIARY SHOWING THAT CROSS-COMPLAINANT IS LIKELY TO PREVAIL ON THE CROSS-COMPLAINT. THIS MOTION, AS IT BASED UPON THE CONTENTION THAT THERE HAS BEEN A FINDING AFTER ARBITRATION, DOES NOT SUPPORT THE ISSUANCE OF A WRIT OF ATTACHMENT. ANY CONTENTION THAT CROSS-COMPLAINANT IS ENTITLED TO A JUDGMENT MUST BE BY A PETITION TO CONFIRM THE ARBITRATION. WHILE A PARTY MAY SEEK PROVISIONAL RELIEF EVEN THOUGH IT MUST BE SUBMITTED TO ARBITRATION, THE AVAILABILITY OF THE PROVISIONAL RELIEF DOES NOT CHANGE THE REQUIREMENT OF AN EVIDENTIARY SHOWING THAT THE PARTY SEEKING THE RELIEF WOULD PREVAIL.
